question.text: When an option is exercised, the STT applicable is:

answer.text: 0.125% of the settlement price, payable by the purchaser
0.0625% of the premium, payable by the seller
0.0125% of the contract value, payable by both parties

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series VIII workbook (page 195), STT on the exercise of an option is 0.125 per cent on the settlement price, payable by the purchaser. The Trap: The other rates and payers (0.0625% on premium by seller, 0.0125% on contract value by both, or no STT) are not the rate or base set out for option exercise. Note: Source: NISM Series VIII workbook, page 195.
